title: Add task detail panel to TasksApp
description: When a task is selected in TasksApp, show a detail panel with the full task information including title, description, passCondition, and optional blockedReason.
acceptanceCriteria: Selecting a task shows its full details in the detail panel
Detail panel shows blockedReason if present
Panel uses a Box border for visual separation

steps.description: Add detail panel to TasksApp layout
steps.details: In TasksApp, use a horizontal layout: <Box><Box width='40%'>{task list}</Box><Box width='60%' borderStyle='round' padding={1}>{detail panel}</Box></Box>
Create inline component: function TaskDetail({ task }: { task: Task | null }). If task is null, render 'Select a task to view details'. Otherwise render all task fields.

steps.description: Render task fields in detail panel
steps.details: Render: <Box flexDirection='column'><Text bold>#{task.id} {task.title}</Text><Text marginTop={1}>{task.description}</Text><Text marginTop={1} color='cyan'>Pass condition: {task.passCondition}</Text>{task.blockedReason && <Text color='red'>Blocked: {task.blockedReason}</Text>}</Box>
